usage: 冬菇釀肉係一道粵菜點心，通常用作餐桌上的小食。
你可以用冬菇釀肉黎做晚餐嘅主菜或者配菜。
冬菇釀肉喺飲茶時非常受歡迎，幾乎每間茶樓都有提供。
英語中，'mushroom stuffed with minced pork' 指嘅係冬菇釀肉，係一種有餡嘅蒸菜。
用法上，冬菇釀肉通常係單數形式，用嚟指一種食品點心。

examples.sentence: 我哋今次飲茶點咗冬菇釀肉，好正！
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 jam2 caa4 dim2 zo2 dung1 gu1 joeng6 juk6, hou2 zeng3!
examples.meaning: We ordered mushroom stuffed with minced pork for dim sum this time, it was delicious!

examples.sentence: 冬菇釀肉係我最鍾意嘅點心之一。
examples.jyutping: dung1 gu1 joeng6 juk6 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 dim2 sam1 zi1 jat1.
examples.meaning: Mushroom stuffed with minced pork is one of my favorite dim sum dishes.

examples.sentence: 媽媽教我點樣做冬菇釀肉，學咗好多。
examples.jyutping: maa4 maa1 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 zou6 dung1 gu1 joeng6 juk6, hok6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.meaning: Mom taught me how to make mushroom stuffed with minced pork, I learned a lot.

examples.sentence: 飲茶嘅時候唔好唔記得試下冬菇釀肉！
examples.jyutping: jam2 caa4 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 si3 haa5 dung1 gu1 joeng6 juk6!
examples.meaning: Don’t forget to try mushroom stuffed with minced pork when you go for dim sum!
